notes: Read all 126 source lines before editing. This is a non-visual behaviour hook (rule 6), ported as native-compatible TypeScript with no DOM, react-i18next, react-router, Recharts, Leaflet, framer-motion, or web UI-kit imports. The module docstring (L17-30) is preserved/expanded in the native header comment.

Imports L1-4: useEffect/useMemo (L1) preserved (plus useCallback/useRef for the inlined helpers); react-i18next useTranslation (L2) -> a local English-fallback useTranslation()/TFunc with {{token}} interpolation, every translation key preserved verbatim (KioskOverlay/RecentlyViewedWidget precedent); `../widgets/types` SavedDashboard (L3) -> the SavedDashboard type chain inlined verbatim (WidgetSize/WidgetConfig/WidgetInstance/RGLLayout/RGLLayouts/DashboardSettings/SavedDashboard) since widgets/types.ts is not yet ported and none of those types carry DOM/lucide deps; `@/hooks/useShortcutRegistry` useShortcut + ShortcutDefinition (L4) -> a native-safe in-memory registry inlined below.

KeyboardOptions interface (L6-15) ported verbatim and exported (editMode/setEditMode/canUndo/canRedo/onUndo/onRedo/dashboards:SavedDashboard[]/switchDashboard). The hook reads only dashboards.length and dashboards[n].id, exactly as the web hook does.
Hook signature + destructure (L31-34) preserved; const {t}=useTranslation() (L35) preserved against the native t.

dashboardShortcuts useMemo (L37-67) ported 1:1: group=t('shortcuts.groups.dashboard','Dashboard') (L38); make(id,keys,description) builds {id:`dashboard.${id}`, keys, description, group, scope:'route', routeMatch:/^\/$/ } (L39-50) verbatim; base seeded with make('toggleEdit',['E'],t('dashboard.shortcuts.toggleEdit','Toggle edit mode')) (L51-53); editMode pushes exitEdit ['Esc'], undo ['Ctrl','Z'], redo ['Ctrl','Y'] with their keys (L54-60); dashboards.length>1 pushes switch ['Alt','1–9'] (en dash preserved) (L61-65); deps [editMode, dashboards.length, t] (L67). useShortcut(dashboardShortcuts) (L68) preserved.

useShortcut + registry: ShortcutScope/ShortcutDefinition retyped against the DOM-free ShortcutKeyEvent for match/handler; registerShortcut/unregisterShortcut/_resetShortcutRegistry/getRegisteredShortcuts + a stableKey()-driven useEffect (the serialised key is the effect dependency, with the latest list held in a ref so cleanup unregisters exactly the ids it registered) mirror the web hook's register-on-mount/unregister-on-cleanup lifecycle while satisfying react-hooks/exhaustive-deps without a disable. The web registry's useSyncExternalStore snapshot, react-router useLocation scope filtering, and single delegated `document` keydown listener are browser-only AND not exercised by this hook (its entries are informational, no match/handler), so they are intentionally omitted (documented in the file header).

Keydown effect (L70-124) -> createDashboardKeydownHandler(options) returns the handler with the full logic preserved 1:1: typing-target guard INPUT/TEXTAREA/SELECT/isContentEditable (L72-76) via the ShortcutKeyEvent.target subset; Alt+1..9 switch with parseInt(e.key,10) and the num>=1 && num<=9 && num<=dashboards.length bound -> switchDashboard(dashboards[num-1].id) (L78-86); bare-key E/e toggle with the Shift-E early return (L89-95); Escape exits when editMode (L96-100); '?' or Shift+'/' (L101-105) -> emitToggleKeyboardShortcuts() replacing window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('toggle-keyboard-shortcuts')); edit-mode-only Ctrl/Meta undo (z, canUndo) and redo (y, or Shift+z, canRedo) with preventDefault (L108-119). e.preventDefault() preserved at every web call site.

Browser-only keydown wiring (window.addEventListener('keydown',handler) L122-123): React Native phones expose no global hardware-keyboard keydown stream, so getKeyboardEventTarget() feature-detects a global addEventListener/removeEventListener and returns null on a stock phone, making the listener effect a documented no-op — the explicit rule-7 unavailable state, surfaced via exported isKeyboardEventTargetAvailable() (false in the RN/jest env). The effect keeps the exact web dependency array [editMode,setEditMode,canUndo,canRedo,onUndo,onRedo,dashboards,switchDashboard] (L124). Trailing blank lines L125-127 are non-code.

window CustomEvent (L103) -> a DOM-free module-level signal hub: emitToggleKeyboardShortcuts() + subscribeToggleKeyboardShortcuts(listener) mirror the web dispatch/addEventListener('toggle-keyboard-shortcuts') pair.

Verification: `npm run typecheck` (tsc --noEmit) exit 0, `npm run lint -- --quiet` exit 0, and `npm test -- --runInBand --detectOpenHandles` pass including the added __tests__/UseLayoutKeyboard.test.tsx, which drives createDashboardKeydownHandler through synthetic events (typing-target guard, Alt+index switch incl. out-of-range, E toggle + Shift-E ignore, Escape exit, ?/Shift+/ signal, Ctrl/Cmd+Z undo + Ctrl+Y / Ctrl+Shift+Z redo, edit-mode/modifier/capability gating), asserts the registry register/expand/unregister lifecycle and entry metadata, asserts isKeyboardEventTargetAvailable() is false with a throw-free mount, and round-trips the toggle signal subscribe/emit/unsubscribe.
